title: llz-argo-bootstrap-apps values
description: Root-strict schema: every top-level key is declared, so a typo (e.g. `componets:`) is REJECTED AT RENDER instead of silently activating nothing. Nested objects stay permissive on purpose — the value here is catching the silent no-op, not freezing every knob. Add nested constraints only where a wrong value is as silent as a wrong key.
